references.text: The Lord's command to Moses to destroy the peoples in Canaan and take possession of the land, as the Gibeonites refer to
The decree that none should remain alive among the nations in the promised land, which the Gibeonites feared would befall them
God's promise to Moses to drive out the peoples in Canaan and give the land to Israel
Rahab expresses similar fear and knowledge of God's plan for Israel to take the land
The Gibeonites' earlier explanation that they had heard about the Lord's deeds
The Lord's command to drive out all the inhabitants of Canaan when Israel crosses the Jordan
God's promise to Joshua to give Israel the whole land, which the Gibeonites had heard about
